entries.message: Groups gather open tabs under a simple header that syncs to every device. Make one from a tab's menu or from selected tabs and name it as you make it, close it to its header, and turn a group into a folder and back. A group goes away when its last tab leaves.
Folders and groups show a … button on their header for their actions, including Archive Tabs and turning a folder of open tabs into a group. A folder's tab count sits where the button appears.
A browser-data import refuses a tab filed in a folder of another section.

A folder of open tabs now goes away once nothing is left in it, as a group does: when its last tab closes or moves out, or its last folder leaves. A folder that still holds a folder stays, and so do saved folders when they empty.

A new tab opens in the group or folder of the tab you're on, at its end, whether you open it with New Tab, from a link or with Duplicate Tab. From a saved folder, New Tab is saved there, while links and copies open with your open tabs.
Remove from Folder and Remove from Group put the tab just below its folder or group instead of at the end of your open tabs.
A tab you put in a folder on one device no longer disappears from every device when the folder is deleted on another at the same time. It stays with your open tabs.
